content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| summarize count(), avg(duration) by name
| order by count_ desc
content.title: Request volume and avg latency by operation (24h)

content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| summarize count() by type, outerMessage
| order by count_ desc
content.title: Exceptions by type (24h)

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where name == "rag.query"
| extend tenant_id = tostring(customDimensions["tenant_id"])
| summarize count() by tenant_id
| order by count_ desc
content.title: Query volume by tenant (24h)
